title: Evaluation of Fairness Trade-offs in Predicting Student Success
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the evaluation of fairness in a predictive model for student success. It investigates the trade-offs between different statistical fairness measures (demographic parity, equality of opportunity, positive predictive parity), which are operationalizations of ethical principles. This constitutes a direct evaluation of ethics within an algorithmic system, going beyond a mere mention of ethical considerations.
